The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of a hydroxy group in the 4-position of the heterocyclic ring and the absence of a hydrogen atom in the 5-position of the 2,1-benzoxazine ring are necessary for the manifestation of the analgesic effect of the compounds studied.
the 2,2-dioxide ring is not a necessary structural element of a potential analgesic agent.
the presence of a 2,1-benzoxazine or 2,1- benzothiazine nucleus with a substituent at position 4 is a key feature in the design of new potent analgetics.
